note: Paid install creatives for the android app, rendered by genads.py into every size in SIZES. Claims are held to what the site already says: free to download with a usable free tier, a paid tier above it, no ads and no data brokers, android only while the iphone build is in progress. Do not write 'completely free' here: there is a paid tier, and a claim the store listing contradicts is how a Meta ad gets rejected or refunded. Five angles rather than one, because a single creative tests nothing. The badge names the category and platform, the button names the price and the store: if those two say the same thing, one of them is wasted.

bestie.sub: it reads ur actual birth chart, ur dasha and today's transits. then talks to u like a person who did the maths.
bestie.angle: Brand warmth, and the line the founder already uses on the site. The safe control: every other creative is measured against this one.

not-a-horoscope.sub: no twelve rotating paragraphs. swiss ephemeris, lahiri ayanamsa, ur real birth details.
not-a-horoscope.angle: The rational differentiator. Speaks to people who already half suspect their current app is generating filler, which is most of them.

birth-time.sub: this one asks for it. that is the entire difference between a column and a chart.
birth-time.angle: One concrete, checkable fact. The strongest hook of the five on paper, because the reader can verify it in four seconds inside whatever app they already have.

four-times.sub: none of it was about u. it was about everyone born inside the same 30 day window.
four-times.angle: Self recognition, and the one most likely to be screenshotted. Also the riskiest: a callout can read as a scold, so watch the comment sentiment, not just the CTR.

no-data-brokers.sub: u are handing over ur birth date, time and city. every other free astrology app is selling that. we do not.
no-data-brokers.angle: Privacy, which is the live anxiety in this category and is true here (it is on the site already). Aimed at the people who will not install a free astrology app precisely because it is free.
